p.src: 1  Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

en: Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
u.src: 1  Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

p.src: 2  As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

en: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.
u.src: 2  As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

p.src: 3  For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.

en: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.
u.src: 3  For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.

p.src: 4  Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

en: Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
u.src: 4  Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

p.src: 5  But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.

en: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
